entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A world of metal originally known as Argentum, created by Karn, later compleated by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The planeswalker who created Mirrodin, brought Phyrexian oil to it, lost his mind and became the Father of Machines and leader of Phyrexia until restored to sanity.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mirrodin's caretaker, who slowly went mad and abducted mortals from across the Multiverse to populate the plane.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: The substance Karn brought to Mirrodin which slowly transformed the creatures it touched.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The force that spread through and compleated Mirrodin, overwhelming the Mirrans.

entities.name: The Mirrans
entities.description: Mirrodin's inhabitants, who fought many battles but were overwhelmed by the Phyrexian forces.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker who could not turn the tide against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker who could not turn the tide against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker who sacrificed his life to restore Karn to sanity.

entities.name: The Praetors
entities.description: Some of Karn's top lieutenants, whose factions fight for power amongst themselves.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The Phyrexian campaign to alter the world of Mirrodin.

events.summary: Memnarch slowly goes mad, abducting mortals from across the Multiverse to populate the plane.
events.quote: Mirrodin's caretaker Memnarch slowly went mad, abducting mortals from across the Multiverse to populate the plane.

events.summary: Karn brings the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin, which begins transforming the creatures it touches.
events.quote: Karn was the bringer of the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin

events.summary: Losing his mind, Karn becomes the Father of Machines and leader of Phyrexia.
events.quote: Slowly losing his mind, Karn became the Father of Machines and the leader of Phyrexia.

events.summary: The slow spread becomes an active campaign to compleat Mirrodin, and the Mirrans are overwhelmed.
events.quote: The Mirrans fought many battles, but they soon were overwhelmed by the Phyrexian forces.

events.summary: Koth, Elspeth and Venser cannot turn the tide, and Venser sacrifices his life to restore Karn to sanity.
events.quote: Venser sacrificed his life to restore Karn to sanity.

events.summary: The Praetors and their factions fight for power amongst themselves while natives struggle to survive.
events.quote: Now the Praetors—some of Karn's top lieutenants—and their factions fight for power amongst themselves
